description: This file provides an API for interacting with the RTL8367C switch's PHY and Serdes registers via OCP, including functions for setting and getting PHY and Serdes register values, as well as handling direct access through internal mechanism.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets PHY OCP registers, with internal address calculation and optional direct register access depending on compilation flags.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets PHY OCP registers, with internal address calculation and optional direct register access.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Sets PHY register by calculating the internal OCP address and calling rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets PHY register by calculating the internal OCP address and calling rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
methods.description: Sets Serdes registers via indirect access registers, specifying sdsId, sdsReg, and sdsPage.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
methods.description: Gets Serdes registers via indirect access registers, including waiting for operation completion.
